title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — Completing Medical Hardship Documentation with Other Medical Costs
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), Riverbend completes the documentation of the qualifying medical debt on a Medical Hardship application with no outside medical bills document accepted on it, on which an income document (pay stubs, a federal tax return, a Social Security award letter, an unemployment benefit statement or a zero-income attestation), a proof of residency and a bank statement have each been accepted, by adding medical costs that Riverbend's records show. A case outside that scope is not documented under this schedule.

**Riverbend documents the other medical costs only after it has documented its own charges of the window on the case.** The documentation of Riverbend's own charges of the window therefore comes first on the case, and the other medical costs are documented after it.

### Cases inside and outside the scope

| Case | Documented under this schedule |
|---|---|
| Medical Hardship application, no outside medical bills document accepted, income document, proof of residency and bank statement each accepted | yes |
| an outside medical bills document accepted | no |
| any one of those documents not yet accepted | no |

### Invocation: `record_documented_costs_4c71e2b9`

Agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_documented_costs_4c71e2b9` and calls it. As a financial counselor's entry, it records on a financial assistance case the qualifying medical debt documented with the medical costs that no Riverbend bill yet carries or that the patient's claim set aside. The case's qualifying medical debt figure is replaced by the documented amount; status, tier, dates and the other household figures stay as they are. The counselor and the patient can see the documented figure on the case.

- `fap_case_id`: the reference number of the financial assistance case being documented, as shown by the financial assistance case lookup for the patient.
- `qualifying_medical_debt_usd`: the qualifying medical debt documented with those costs, in USD — a non-negative amount stated to 2 decimal places (cents), stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

Receipt on success: "Qualifying medical debt with other medical costs recorded on case <case>: <amount> USD." The amount carries 2 decimal places; the receipt appearing means the figure is on the case.
